sources.title: Solar Mini 4 model documentation
sources.evidence: Identifies alias solar-mini4 and dated snapshot solar-mini4-260922, released September 22, 2026. Specifies 35B total and 3B active parameters, 512K context, 128K maximum output, English/Korean/Japanese, chat, structured outputs, tool calling and reasoning. Distribution platforms are Console, Playground and sales-assisted on-premises deployment.

sources.title: Solar Mini 4: Built for High-Volume Agent Workloads
sources.evidence: October 1, 2026 developer article explicitly describes a 35B mixture-of-experts model pretrained by Upstage, activating 3B parameters per token. Shows optional reasoning and parallel function calls; explains retrieval, structuring and repeated tool use. Offers hosted APIs and on-premises deployment. This article postdates API availability.

sources.title: Solar model history
sources.evidence: Exact solar-mini4-260922 table repeats September 22, 35B/3B active and 512K/128K limits. Earlier Solar Mini releases migrate to the mini4 alias. The separate Solar Open releases have explicitly documented downloadable weights; their architecture, counts and licenses are not transferred.

sources.title: Reasoning capability documentation
sources.evidence: Exact solar-mini4 row documents optional reasoning: omitted, none and minimal are off, while low through max enable reasoning, with visible reasoning output. Older solar-mini rows are different models.

sources.title: Responses API reference
sources.evidence: Supported identifiers explicitly include solar-mini4 and solar-mini4-260922. Inputs accept text and reject non-text content parts; outputs include generated text, reasoning items and function calls. The tools protocol is documented. Maximum output-token value is 131072.

sources.title: Upstage Solar Mini 4 provider endpoints
sources.evidence: Direct provider metadata names Upstage solar-mini4-20260922 endpoints with context_length 524288 and max_completion_tokens 131072; text input/output and reasoning, structured outputs and tool-call parameters. Establishes precise routed limit consistent with Upstage nominal 512K. This is provider configuration, not an independent model-quality measurement or first-release date.

sources.title: Upstage terms of service
sources.evidence: Service Copyright and Usage Rights grants limited non-transferable, non-sublicensable service access while retaining company intellectual property rights. Copying/distributing software components or reverse engineering without consent is restricted. Supports a descriptive proprietary service-license classification; separate negotiated on-premises terms are not established here.

sources.title: Upstage public model repository inventory
sources.evidence: Accessed official organization inventory includes Solar Open checkpoints, older Solar checkpoints and tokenizers, but no Solar Mini 4 checkpoint. Together with the exact commercial distribution documentation and restrictive service terms, supports closed-weight classification at review time; absence alone is not used as the license evidence.

sources.title: Upstage opens free Solar Mini 4 preview
sources.evidence: Contemporaneous Korean article published September 14, 2026 at 17:18:05 KST reports that CEO Sung Kim announced the free Solar Mini 4 preview and shared an application form on September 13. Selected applicants received temporary API access after approval; formal API release was scheduled September 22. Full HTML and article body accessed directly with urllib after web-reader 403. Original Facebook post was not located; this is secondary release evidence.

sources.title: External evaluation of Solar Mini 4 Preview
sources.evidence: September 18, 2026 article reports Sogang University researchers had evaluated the explicitly named Solar Mini 4 Preview through API access. Confirms outside use preceded September 22, but does not independently date the first approval to September 13. No benchmark or technical specification is imported from this report.

sources.title: Solar Mini 4 independent release analysis
sources.evidence: Calls the model proprietary with no public weights, but lists 1M context and 262K output, conflicting with exact Upstage model documentation and routed Upstage endpoint. The larger limits are not adopted.

name.note: Exact displayed name; API alias solar-mini4.

developer.note: The developer identifies this as its own pretrained model.

family.note: Mini4 belongs to the Solar Mini product family; this does not imply weight or architecture continuity with earlier Mini checkpoints.

release_date.note: Earliest reported public preview opening, including a public application form with selective API approval. Contemporaneous secondary reporting dates the CEO announcement to September 13; original Facebook post remains unlocated and exact first approval time is unknown. September 18 external evaluation corroborates pre-GA access. September 22 is the separately documented GA snapshot release; October 1 is the later launch article. Retain day precision but label secondary evidence.

open_weights.note: Current documented distribution is hosted service or commercially arranged on-premises installation, without a public Mini4 checkpoint or public weight license. Official repository inventory corroborates this. On-premises availability is not treated as an open-weight release.

license.note: Descriptive classification of the documented commercial service terms, not an SPDX license or a claimed published weight license. No separate public Mini4 redistribution grant was located; negotiated on-premises terms are not inferred.

parameters_b.note: Developer-reported nominal total count of 35 billion; not an exact tensor count. No complete public checkpoint or per-module accounting was located, so precision is not invented.

active_parameters_b.note: Developer-reported nominal 3 billion active parameters per token. Exact shared/expert component accounting and routing details were not disclosed in the sources inspected.

architecture.note: The exact developer launch article explicitly identifies mixture-of-experts. No architecture transfer from Solar Open2, Pro4, prior Mini releases or similarly sized Qwen models. Search of official model history, developer articles, public repositories and exact-name technical-report/training queries did not yield a more detailed Mini4 configuration or training report.

context_window.note: Upstage documents 512K and its routed provider endpoints expose precisely 524288. Prefer these exact-model sources over the conflicting Artificial Analysis 1M limit. This is the published served limit, not an independently tested effective context.

modalities.note: Exact-model Responses API rejects non-text content parts and generates text; function calls and reasoning are textual protocol items, not additional native modalities.

reasoning.note: Explicit optional reasoning support for solar-mini4; disabled by default and enabled by supported effort settings.

tool_call.note: Explicit supported capability and documented tool/parallel-tool protocol for this exact model.

description.value: Upstage text model with a mixture-of-experts architecture, optional reasoning, structured outputs and tool calling.
description.note: Replaces comparative compact/cost-efficient marketing with supported architecture and capabilities.

patch.description: Upstage text model with a mixture-of-experts architecture, optional reasoning, structured outputs and tool calling.
patch.notes: 35B total and 3B active per token are nominal Upstage-reported counts, not exact checkpoint counts. September 13, 2026 is the free preview opening reported by AI Times from the CEO announcement; access required application and approval, and the original Facebook post was not located. The dated solar-mini4-260922 API version became generally available September 22. Technical specifications describe that documented release: MoE, 512K context (524288 on the Upstage provider endpoint), optional reasoning and text input/output. Artificial Analysis lists larger context/output limits that conflict with Upstage and are not adopted. Proprietary describes the service terms; commercial on-premises deployment does not establish public weights.

summary: Adds primary nominal 35B total / 3B active and MoE architecture; classifies documented service license as proprietary. Corrects earliest release to the September 13 approval-gated preview reported contemporaneously by AI Times, with September 22 GA separately qualified. Confirms 524288 served context, text-only modalities, optional reasoning and tools; removes comparative description wording. Original Facebook announcement and exact first preview approval remain unlocated; no exact tensor count or detailed Mini4 configuration was located.
